OUR TERMS

Terms & conditions

Last updated: 1 October 2026

These terms apply to the digital services provided by Surecomply Services and to the use of this website. Please read them together with the written quote or project agreement and the policies linked below.

1. Scope of services

We offer website setup, document formatting, and digital design. The specific deliverables, file formats, revisions, fees, and timeline for each project are set out in a written quote or project agreement accepted by you before work starts.

2. Quotes and payments

Prices are quoted in INR. The quote identifies any applicable taxes, additional costs, payment schedule, and validity period. We obtain your agreement before performing work outside the accepted scope or incurring additional charges. Payment instructions are provided with the accepted quote or invoice.

3. Client materials and approvals

You are responsible for supplying accurate information and materials that you are entitled to use. Please obtain any permissions needed for text, logos, photos, or other assets. Delays in materials, feedback, or approvals may affect the delivery schedule; any revised timeline will be communicated.

4. Revisions and handover

The quote specifies the included revisions. New requirements and revisions outside that allowance are quoted separately. The final formats and handover arrangements follow the accepted scope and our service delivery policy.

5. Ownership and third-party services

Your existing content remains yours. The project agreement specifies the rights granted in final deliverables after payment. Third-party fonts, images, software, platforms, and other licensed materials remain subject to their own terms. Any paid third-party service must be agreed separately.

6. Cancellations and refunds

Requests are handled under our refund and cancellation policy. Contact us with the project reference and reason for the request.

7. Service limitations

We do not guarantee sales, search rankings, payment gateway approval, or approval by any third party. These services do not include legal advice, regulatory certification, or government representation.

8. Privacy and concerns

Our privacy policy explains the handling of enquiry and project information. If you have a concern, contact us so we can review it and work toward a resolution. Nothing in these terms excludes rights that cannot lawfully be excluded.

9. Updates

Updates to these website terms will be shown with a revised date. Material changes to an existing project require agreement and do not automatically change an accepted quote.
